notes: Scope: this independent run read only the assigned scan-002 packet and brief v01. It did not inspect any other page image, reader return or external source. The packet's cross-page statements were not treated as evidence about another scan.

Viewing discipline: the whole image was opened once for layout at 08:57:12 UTC; half A once at 08:57:18; half B once at 08:57:43, in that order. All lines, including text where C and H agree, were compared with the ink. Each of the 21 stored tight crops was inspected once. PIL was used only for crop, grayscale, autocontrast, LANCZOS scaling and sharpening; no OCR or text-layer software was used.

The page is a typescript with manuscript corrections. It has an upper page number 1 and a lower-left archive numeral 1. The upper-right hand writes 9/74 and Envoyé par Grothendieck. The visible hands have not been assigned to a named historical person. The byline names Mme Hoang Xuan Sinh. No total page count is written on this sheet.

The title is Esquisse d'une théorie des Gr-Catégories. The introduction calls the text a résumé of results belonging to a detailed work which the author intends to present shortly as a doctoral thesis. Both empty reference brackets are retained empty.

The definition paragraph calls its categories tensor-catégories AU, with associativity and unit isomorphisms subject to compatibility conditions referred to in loc. cit. The groupoid condition c'est un groupoïde, et si is an interlinear insertion. The inverse-object formula has two handwritten isomorphism signs and typed units. These are statements transcribed from the page, not results checked in this run.

Example 1 uses based loops, classes d'homotopie d'homotopies, and loop composition. The singular/plural pair is deliberate in the diplomatic reading. The text itself says composition is not associative, but associative à homotopie près. Its variant uses the repeated composite capital for a Hopf space, including the qualification en un sens suffisamment fort and the statement that a classifying space recovers the earlier example essentiellement.

The left marginal note calls the first example a particular case of the next and shows G and Ω^1(X,x), followed by espace des lacets. Several word beginnings and any equality sign are clipped by the page edge. The exponent 1 is secure; equality is not. The marginal pointer is rendered as a small TikZ drawing, not a mathematical diagram.

Example 2 states the torsor construction for a sheaf F, calls it even a strict Picard category, and relates invertible Modules on a locally ringed space/topos to F=underlined O_X with star. The word localement and the star are handwritten additions. No missing assumption has been supplied, and no validity check of the assertion was attempted.

Example 3 concerns equivalences of A with itself in underlined Hom(A,A) with the handwritten is index, and then objects in an arbitrary 2-category. The page stops during a further example about a sheaf of groups. The continuation on the following sheet was neither read nor guessed.

H's note calling the crossed NB continuation typed does not fit its joined pen ductus. H's note calling the s in Exemples crossed out also does not fit the surviving live pen contour as well as C's added-s reading. The cancelled old first numeral and the two deleted underlined Exemple labels are retained visibly.

The repeated variant glyph remains an alphabet/overstrike problem. The reading keeps C's leading double-struck-G candidate at the first occurrence, explicitly adds the E alternative, and then follows the required recurring-glyph convention. This should not be taken as a claim that the special alphabet is established. A plain G or a K/E-like overstrike remains possible.

The final masked run after qui lui même/mêmes is recorded as approximately two unreadable words. Dense cancellation prevents a secure count or another lexical recovery. No hyphen between lui and même is supplied because any such mark would be inseparable from the cancellation.

Retained C alerts, including clear abbreviation and symbol decisions, are included in changes with both against flags false. Changes in macro names alone are not counted. The initial cotefile marker present in the extracted C packet was omitted from reading.tex because the brief requires scan 002 to begin with scanpage, without a new cote marker.

Main-reader adjudication crops are still needed for differences already settled directly from a half: the baseline x in CxC; paired straight quotes around inversible, inverse and à homotopie près; and the deleted underlined Exemple labels before 2 and 3. No redundant reader crop was made for these settled places. The other differing loci have the crop references listed in changes.
No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, formal computation, or theorem validation was carried out. Visual symbol verification is not a mathematical check; math_checks is therefore empty.
